summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan. Core deliverable is one new mechanized wrapper script (git-commit-phase.sh) that derives the phase-commit stage list from the phase's own progress-file files_touched arrays, invokes git-commit-scoped.sh unpiped, and then verifies every derived path is clean against HEAD, exiting 6 and naming each dirty path otherwise. Supporting phases add its N-vs-N-1 fixture suite, migrate both phase-commit call sites in general-implementation-agent.md, mechanize the no-pipe requirement as a new rule in lint-scoped-commit-boundary.sh (already wired into verify-deploy gate 17), and correct the two durable records still carrying the disproven cause. Plan passes validate-artifact.sh in both default and --strict mode.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan across three dependency waves, 6.25 estimated hours, covering all four dispatch scope items.
